input: Find arts, crafts, music, theater and dance summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Black Mountain, Swannanoa, Montreat and Old Fort, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Black Mountain Swannanoa summer camp art music theater dance 2026 2025

candidates.name: Black Mountain Center for the Arts
candidates.note: 2026 performance arts camps for ages 3–9 combine singing, dance, crafts and a weekly stage showcase.

candidates.name: We Rock Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 music camp for ages 8–16 at ArtSpace Charter School, with musical experimentation, band collaboration and a showcase.

candidates.name: Warren Wilson College — The Swannanoa Gathering
candidates.note: Summer children's program for ages 6–12 offers crafts, creativity and music; minors may also enroll in music workshops with an adult chaperone.

candidates.name: Montreat Conference Center
candidates.note: 2026 summer Clubs program serves children through graduating seniors; activities include music, crafts, dancing and outdoor recreation.

candidates.name: Presbyterian Association of Musicians
candidates.note: 2027 Worship & Music Conference welcomes children and youth for a week of music-making, classes and worship.

candidates.name: Black Mountain Recreation & Parks
candidates.note: June–August summer day camp for rising grades 1–6 includes arts and crafts, STEM projects and local exploration.

candidates.name: Camp Rockmont
candidates.note: 2027 boys' camp for ages 7–17 offers ceramics, crafts, guitar, photography, leatherworking and theater/improv alongside outdoor activities.

candidates.name: Camp Merri-Mac
candidates.note: Girls' overnight camp ran in 2026 with dance, artwork, acting and musical performance opportunities.

candidates.name: Cragmont Assembly
candidates.note: 2026 youth summer camp weeks for ages 9–18 include music, worship, instruction and recreation.
